Wraps the string in a custom {@link CharSequence} whose {@link Object#equals(Object)} deliberately does NOT match a plain {@link String}, ensuring the implementation handles arbitrary {@link CharSequence} types rather than relying on {@code String.equals}. @param string the string to wrap @return a {@link CharSequence} backed by {@code string}
